# Velayon Dynamics

> Velayon Dynamics is a Nepal-based digital products and software studio founded by Bibek Kumar Thagunna. It creates original downloadable products and clearly scoped website and mobile application projects for customers worldwide.

Canonical website: https://velayon.com
Contact: https://velayon.com/contact
Location: Kathmandu, Nepal; remote delivery worldwide

## Entity facts

- Brand: Velayon Dynamics (also known as Velayon)
- Founder: Bibek Kumar Thagunna
- Work: original digital products, responsive websites, Flutter applications, React Native with Expo applications, native Android applications and practical AI systems
- Digital products are sold as one-time purchases with clearly stated deliverables and licence terms.
- Custom development services are separately scoped and invoiced; they are not sold through the digital-product checkout.

For the latest and authoritative information, use the canonical pages above.
